info.name: Box Authorize Authorization Storage Policy Assignments API

params.name: marker
params.description:
Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is
used when paginating using marker-based pagination.

This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.

params.name: resolved_for_type
params.description: The target type to return assignments for

params.name: resolved_for_id
params.description: The ID of the user or enterprise to return assignments for

items.docs: Fetches all the storage policy assignment for an enterprise or user.
Creates a storage policy assignment for an enterprise or user.

params.name: storage_policy_assignment_id
params.description: The ID of the storage policy assignment.

items.docs: Fetches a specific storage policy assignment.

params.name: storage_policy_assignment_id
params.description: The ID of the storage policy assignment.

items.docs: Updates a specific storage policy assignment.

params.name: storage_policy_assignment_id
params.description: The ID of the storage policy assignment.

items.docs:
Delete a storage policy assignment.

Deleting a storage policy assignment on a user
will have the user inherit the enterprise's default
storage policy.

There is a rate limit for calling this endpoint of only
twice per user in a 24 hour time frame.
